description: This file defines functions for making authenticated HTTP requests to a backend API, specifically for operations related to work items, including GET and POST requests, as well as utility functions to build URLs. It exports functions for fetching work items, creating new work items, and generic API call functions with error handling.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON POST request to the backend and returns parsed JSON or throws an error.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters, handling URL encoding and error parsing.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches work items from backend, optionally filtered by projectId.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item with provided properties, following backend API specifications.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs and returns a full URL for the given API path based on current base URL.

ctags.name: createWorkItem
ctags.pattern: /^export async function createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priori/
ctags.signature: ({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
